body.name: Restriction transcript \(\tau_j\)
body.construction: \(\tau_j=((U_0,H_0,B_0),\ldots,(U_m,H_m,B_m))\) records the chosen source \(U_0=T\), each value-matching ancestor set \(H_r=\operatorname{An}_{C_j}(D_T[U_r])\), and the retained bidirected district \(B_r\) containing \(C_j\), terminating with \(H_m=C_j\).
